fusions.name: Barbed Fang
fusions.desc: A barbed bite at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that deals 5 piercing damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled Into the Coils
fusions.desc: Opens a snare 6.5 tiles long ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Each enemy it catches takes 12 poison damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hooked and Held
fusions.desc: You pull up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Fang-Blade
fusions.desc: Conjures a barbed fang-blade. It increases your weapon damage by 10%, your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
